pages.text: Dividing [[undoes]] multiplying. 12 ÷ 3 asks what times 3 makes 12. Four hops of 3 from 0 land on 12, so 12 ÷ 3 = 4.

pages.name: Hops of −3
pages.task: Work out −12 ÷ −3. Hop −3 at a time from 0 until the marker lands on −12.
pages.why: Four hops of −3 land on −12, so 4 × −3 = −12 and −12 ÷ −3 = 4. The signs match, so the answer is positive.

pages.name: Two negatives
pages.why: Two hops of −4 land on −8, so −8 ÷ −4 = 2. Check, 2 × −4 = −8. The signs match, so the answer is positive.

pages.name: What times −3?
pages.task: 12 ÷ −3 has no hop picture. So what times −3 makes 12?
pages.why: Hops of −3 only go down, so none land on 12. But −4 × −3 = 12, as two half-turns bring 4 × 3 = 12 back to 12. So 12 ÷ −3 = −4.

pages.task: Say someone works out −20 ÷ −4 = −5. Multiply back to check it. What is −5 × −4?
pages.why: −5 × −4 = 20, not −20, so −5 is wrong. The signs in −20 ÷ −4 match, so the answer is 5. Check, 5 × −4 = −20.

pages.name: Zero
pages.why: 0 × −6 = 0, so 0 ÷ −6 = 0, which is neither positive nor negative. Dividing by 0 is different. No number times 0 makes 6, so 6 ÷ 0 has no answer. And 0 ÷ 0 has no one answer, since every number times 0 makes 0.
